text:
But why not give it
a little more time and effort?
I'm sure your father and mother
got stronger
that very same way.
...Yeah!
But why do you
want to get so strong
in the first place, Subaru?
But why do you
want to get so strong
in the first place, Subaru?
Isn't it obvious?
I want to be a strong man like Father
so I can
protect Mother!
I don't want to see
Mother cry anymore.
Huh?
I know about it.
Sometimes Mother cries
in front of Father's grave...
!
Mother's strong,
but I think
she's lonely inside.
I think she's scared
now that Father isn't here
to protect her anymore.
That's why I
have to get stronger!
I have to become a grown-up soon
and put
Mother's mind at ease.
That's what I think.
I see...
Don't tell Mother
what I just told you, okay?
I see...
You're very kind,
Subaru...
Hehehe...
Don't tell Mother
what I just told you, okay?
All right. I won't.
It's a promise between men.
Yeah!
Genji,
don't you want to return
to your own world?
Genji,
don't you want to return
to your own world?
I can't say I have
much desire to go back.
My role in that world
is more or less
finished, you see.
Huh?
I served out my entire career
as a teacher, and I lived
to see my grandchildren.
My wife passed on before me.
Just as I was wondering what
to do next, I was summoned here.
...
Don't look at me like that,
you fool.
This island is
quite a decent place
to spend my remaining years.
It's far more fulfilling
than drifting through life
with nothing to do.
Genji...
And besides, I still
have to educate
a young teacher like you.
It seems a peaceful retirement
is still a long way off!
